title: How It Works
subtitle: Simple steps to unlock your child's potential with our comprehensive assessment platform.

step1.title: Create Child Profile
step1.description: Set up your child's profile with basic information, developmental history, and specific areas of concern to personalize the assessment experience.

step2.title: Choose Assessment Type
step2.description: Select from our comprehensive suite of evidence-based assessments tailored to your child's specific needs and developmental stage.

step3.title: Complete Interactive Assessment
step3.description: Engage with our AI-powered assessment tools through interactive games and multimedia activities designed to be both fun and informative.

step4.title: Receive Detailed Report
step4.description: Get comprehensive insights and personalized recommendations based on your child's assessment results, including next steps and resources.
